title: pseudognaphalium micradenium
intro: Pseudognaphalium micradenium, commonly known as Mexican chamomile, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is traditionally used as a calming agent and is considered a natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The health benefits of Pseudognaphalium micradenium include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
